v.version_id, v.activity_id, a.slug as preset_scene_id, s.slug as space_id, v.version, v.title_zh as title, v.summary_zh as summary, v.scene_tag_en as scene_tag, v.coach_tip_zh as coach_tip, v.sort_order, v.generation_brief, v.enabled, v.lock_version, v.created_by_admin_id, v.published_by_admin_id, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.published_at

v.version_id, v.activity_id, a.slug as preset_scene_id, s.slug as space_id, v.title_zh as title, v.summary_zh as summary, v.scene_tag_en as scene_tag, v.coach_tip_zh as coach_tip, v.sort_order, v.generation_brief, v.enabled, v.lock_version, v.created_by_admin_id, v.created_at, v.updated_at
mapper.select: select , draft.lock_version as draft_lock_version, draft.updated_at as draft_updated_at from practice_activities a join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id join practice_preset_scene_versions v on v.version_id = a.current_published_version_id and v.activity_id = a.id and v.state = 'published' left join practice_preset_scene_versions draft on draft.activity_id = a.id and draft.state = 'draft' order by v.sort_order asc, a.slug asc

select from practice_activities a join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id join practice_preset_scene_versions v on v.version_id = a.current_published_version_id and v.activity_id = a.id and v.state = 'published' where a.slug = #{presetSceneId}

select from practice_preset_scene_versions v join practice_activities a on a.id = v.activity_id join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id where a.slug = #{presetSceneId} and v.state = 'draft' for update of v
select from practice_preset_scene_versions v join practice_activities a on a.id = v.activity_id join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id where a.slug = #{presetSceneId} and v.state = 'draft'

with inserted as ( insert into practice_preset_scene_versions ( activity_id, version, state, title_zh, summary_zh, scene_tag_en, coach_tip_zh, sort_order, generation_brief, enabled, lock_version, created_by_admin_id, created_at, updated_at ) select a.id, null, 'draft', #{write.title}, #{write.summary}, #{write.sceneTag}, #{write.coachTip}, #{write.sortOrder}, #{write.generationBrief}, #{write.enabled}, 0, #{adminId}, #{now}, #{now} from practice_activities a where a.slug = #{presetSceneId} returning * ) select from inserted v join practice_activities a on a.id = v.activity_id join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id

with updated as ( update practice_preset_scene_versions v set title_zh = #{write.title}, summary_zh = #{write.summary}, scene_tag_en = #{write.sceneTag}, coach_tip_zh = #{write.coachTip}, sort_order = #{write.sortOrder}, generation_brief = #{write.generationBrief}, enabled = #{write.enabled}, lock_version = v.lock_version + 1, updated_at = #{now} from practice_activities a where v.activity_id = a.id and a.slug = #{presetSceneId} and v.state = 'draft' and v.lock_version = #{expectedLockVersion} returning v.* ) select from updated v join practice_activities a on a.id = v.activity_id join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id
select id from practice_activities where slug = #{presetSceneId} for update
select coalesce(max(version), 0) + 1 from practice_preset_scene_versions where activity_id = #{activityId} and state = 'published'

with updated as ( update practice_preset_scene_versions v set version = #{nextVersion}, state = 'published', published_by_admin_id = #{adminId}, published_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, lock_version = v.lock_version + 1 from practice_activities a where v.activity_id = a.id and a.slug = #{presetSceneId} and v.state = 'draft' and v.lock_version = #{expectedLockVersion} returning v.* ) select from updated v join practice_activities a on a.id = v.activity_id join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id

with inserted as ( insert into practice_preset_scene_versions ( activity_id, version, state, title_zh, summary_zh, scene_tag_en, coach_tip_zh, sort_order, generation_brief, enabled, lock_version, created_by_admin_id, created_at, updated_at ) select a.id, null, 'draft', source.title_zh, source.summary_zh, source.scene_tag_en, source.coach_tip_zh, source.sort_order, source.generation_brief, source.enabled, 0, #{adminId}, #{now}, #{now} from practice_activities a join practice_preset_scene_versions source on source.activity_id = a.id and source.version = #{sourceVersion} and source.state = 'published' where a.slug = #{presetSceneId} returning * ) select from inserted v join practice_activities a on a.id = v.activity_id join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id

with inserted as ( insert into practice_preset_scene_versions ( activity_id, version, state, title_zh, summary_zh, scene_tag_en, coach_tip_zh, sort_order, generation_brief, enabled, lock_version, created_by_admin_id, published_by_admin_id, created_at, updated_at, published_at ) select source.activity_id, #{nextVersion}, 'published', source.title_zh, source.summary_zh, source.scene_tag_en, source.coach_tip_zh, source.sort_order, source.generation_brief, source.enabled, source.lock_version, #{adminId}, #{adminId}, #{now}, #{now}, #{now} from practice_activities a join practice_preset_scene_versions source on source.activity_id = a.id and source.version = #{sourceVersion} and source.state = 'published' where a.slug = #{presetSceneId} returning * ) select from inserted v join practice_activities a on a.id = v.activity_id join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id

select from practice_preset_scene_versions v join practice_activities a on a.id = v.activity_id join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id where a.slug = #{presetSceneId} and v.state = 'published' order by v.version desc
